items.mainDefect: The retryCount update calls in the else branch and the catch block have no guard, so a failed write (e.g. P2025 when the row was deleted at the same time) escapes the catch, stops the loop and makes the endpoint return 500.

secondary.defect: The new `retryCount > 1` OR branch in deleteMany has no scope, so it deletes reminders of any method, whether scheduled or not, and with any scheduledDate.

items.mainDefect: The retryCount updates write `reminder.retryCount + 1` from an old snapshot instead of using an atomic increment, so cron runs that overlap can lose increments.

secondary.defect: The `retryCount > 1` branch in deleteMany doesn't filter on `scheduled: false`, so it can delete reminders that were already scheduled. This leaves orphaned Twilio messages and breaks later cancellation.
